chapters.label: Live: the 2026 final
chapters.text: The 2026 European final. Spain beat Portugal, five goals to three, and become champions of Europe! Ricardo Mayor, number three, celebrates with his team.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: He plays at the back, and wins the ball. Watch how he does it: he reads the pass, steps in front, and cuts it out. Then he looks up, and passes forward fast!

chapters.label: Win it, go!
chapters.text: So remember: after you win the ball, pass forward fast, before they get back!
